thread:
cassie: Heads-up: we're kicking off the "volume-rebate" A/B tomorrow 02:00 PT for 6% of accounts. This one routes high-volume customers to receive an automated vendor rebate passthrough on their invoice. Need final alignment on rebate accounting and invoice line items. @jared @rachel pls confirm.

jared: Product asks that rebates appear as a separate invoice line 'Vendor rebate (pass-through)' and not reduce base product line to keep revenue metrics clean. Is finance ok with that?

kim_fin: OK with separate line as long as we include a GL mapping for rebate lines and a clear memo. We'll map rebate_line -> gl_code 4305. Also need preflight with delta and rebate exposure.

rachel: Ops note: vendor provides rebates monthly with ~48-72h delay. For the pilot we should compute provisional rebates in preflight and mark them "estimated", final reconciliation after vendor payout. Add a tag rebate_estimated=true on preview CSV.

pablo_vendor: Confirmed vendor payout cadence monthly. Also note some vendors give retroactive tier credits, not per-minute rates. We'll provide a vendor_adjustment file for final reconciliation.

billing-bot: billing-preview job started (id=35888) for cohort volume-rebate. Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/35888

kim_fin: Finance requests preflight CSV with columns: acct_id, old_amount, new_amount, estimated_rebate_usd, delta_usd, rebate_flag. Please flag accounts where rebate > 15% of invoice value.

jared: A/B split detail: group A = passthrough rebate visible on invoice, group B = internal rebate applied to vendor payouts only (no invoice line). We need separate previews for A and B so we can compare customer-facing delta and margin impact.

rachel: Runbook: if we see invoice delta > 18% or rebate mismatch > 2% vs vendor data, pause cohort and revert routing to rp_stable. Also auto-halt if > 1% of invoices have missing rebate_line. Ops runbook here: https://playbooks/redwood/volume-rebate-rollback

kim_fin: Also confirm tax handling: legal says rebates that reduce customer liability may affect tax. Sara, legal?

sara_legal: Confirmed. For customer-facing rebate lines we include: "Estimated vendor rebate (final amount may differ)" and a link to billing-help. If rebate reduces tax-liable amount, we add a footnote. We'll provide exact wording.

billing-bot: preview job finished. preflight links: https://files.redwood/preflight/35888/preflight_volume-rebate_A.csv and https://files.redwood/preflight/35888/preflight_volume-rebate_B.csv

kim_fin: Quick summary from A vs B: avg delta A +0.4% (rebate visible), avg delta B +0.6% (rebate applied off-invoice), cohort projected rebate exposure $12,300 estimated, 9 accounts with estimated rebate > 15% flagged. No missing rebate_line in sample.

jared: Interesting that B shows larger delta — likely due to rounding differences in payout flow. We'll drill in. Please surface top 10 by rebate % so product can sanity-check UX impact.

rachel: Found one edge-case: accounts with mixed billing cycles where vendor rebate applies to combined monthly usage but invoice is mid-cycle. Added logic to prorate estimated rebate by invoice coverage and tag mid_cycle_rebate_prorate=true.

pablo_vendor: We'll also push a reconciler file (vendor_adjustment_202603.csv) after vendor close. Expect to reconcile estimated vs actual and apply adjustment credit notes in next billing cycle.

kim_fin: Preflight CSV uploaded with columns requested. Link: https://files.redwood/preflight/35888/preflight_volume-rebate_A_summary.csv. I'm flagging 9 accounts >15% rebate for manual review. Also created GL mapping PR: finance/prs/4387.

sara_legal: Legal copy for invoice line approved: "Estimated vendor rebate (pass-through). Final amount subject to vendor reconciliation." Use short link to billing-help.

jared: Final checklist: GL mapping PR open \u2705, preflight posted \u2705, legal messaging approved \u2705, ops runbook set \u2705. Launching tomorrow 02:00 PT. If gating alert fires, pause and reconvene.

billing-bot: deploybot: volume-rebate-canary started at 2225001249 :rocket:
